lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Everyone tells my story wrong. Let me try.
lines.text: Everyone tells my story wrong. Let me try.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I was a gravedigger's son. I grew up|among the dead. They were better company.
lines.text: I was a gravedigger's son. I grew up among the dead. They were better company.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The Master found me reading tombstones|by one candle. He said: this one, too.
lines.text: The Master found me reading tombstones by one candle. He said: this one, too.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Too. Fourth of four. Fire was his joy,|ice his patience, the wood his heart.
lines.text: Too. Fourth of four. Fire was his joy, ice his patience, the wood his heart.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: And me? He gave me what was left over.|The dark. As if it were a kindness.
lines.text: And me? He gave me what was left over. The dark. As if it were a kindness.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then he vanished and left us nothing.|So I took. That is the whole secret.
lines.text: Then he vanished and left us nothing. So I took. That is the whole secret.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I took the dark and taught it to kneel.|I took knives, and a woman who never misses.
lines.text: I took the dark and taught it to kneel. I took knives, and a woman who never misses.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: She missed. Emberfall. Then the Hollow.|I lost, and lost, and every time I lost,
lines.text: She missed. Emberfall. Then the Hollow. I lost, and lost, and every time I lost,

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I kept something. A candle. A knife.|A stone that still beats in my hand.
lines.text: I kept something. A candle. A knife. A stone that still beats in my hand.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: It whispers. Let it. I am the one who|listens, and I am the one who decides.
lines.text: It whispers. Let it. I am the one who listens, and I am the one who decides.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: That is how a gravedigger's son grows|strong: he never puts the shovel down.
lines.text: That is how a gravedigger's son grows strong: he never puts the shovel down.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Look at it. The last green country.|Flowers to the knee. The Master's garden.
lines.text: Look at it. The last green country. Flowers to the knee. The Master's garden.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: They will stand there and tell me to stop.|Fire. Roots. An old man's storm.
lines.text: They will stand there and tell me to stop. Fire. Roots. An old man's storm.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I have heard "stop" all my life.
lines.text: I have heard "stop" all my life.
